spans.text: ■FILE■ PACC37628974108749—Decrypting...
Samantha Shaw (2009-2062),
Formerly known as Yekaterina Vasilievna Petrovskaya.
Born in Mineralnye Vody, Stavropol Krai in 2009.
2015-2019, attended Mineralnye Vody Primary School No. 1 [Attachment 3].
2022, attended secondary school [Attachment 9].
Family relations—one sister,
Sofya Vasilievna Petrovskaya (2001-?).
Decrypting Attachment 3...
In a lecture theater.
The lecture theater is bustling with activity. The front row is full of 4th graders.
Parents are seated on the back row, all with their camera phones pointing at the podium.
A banner is hung above the stage; it reads, "Award Ceremony for the 2019 Mineralnye Vody Primary School No. 1 Model Aircraft Competition (4th Grade Division)".
Next up, the winner of the first place for hand launch gliders is...
Viktor Ivanovich Erikov!
A boy of medium build walks up to the stage with his head held high and accepts the certificate from the teacher.
I've always known I'd win this award!
Since I was very little, my mama and papa would encourage me...
Ah!!!
Viktor is suddenly shoved away from the microphone by a blonde girl who has charged up the stage.
Yekaterina, what are you doing?! Get off the stage!
Yekaterina nimbly dodges Viktor's swipe and grabs the microphone.
Guys! Viktor stole my model! He's a liar! I'm the real winner!
W-who are you calling a thief? Shove off!
Viktor yanks Yekaterina's braid viciously.
Stop it, both of you!
Chaos erupts on the stage, causing the microphone to emit an ear-splitting screech in a burst of feedback. Many in the audience have to cover their ears.
Another blonde girl squeezes past the crowd of parents who are built like bears and rushes up the stage.
Seeing this blonde girl, Yekaterina's obstinate scowl finally crumbles, and she bursts into tears.
Sestritsa!
Sofya, there you are! Quick, get your little sister off the stage!
I'm not going! I want my certificate!
I'm the winner! She's lying!
This is no place to be making a scene! Sofya, get your sister home!
Why should we go home before we figure out the truth?
...What's the matter with you?
This is a public event!
...Then isn't this the perfect opportunity to clear things up?
I know Katya wouldn't lie. Since she claims that the model was hers, we should let them both make the model again, right here in front of everyone.
If Katya can't do it, I will make a public apology and punish Katya, then I will personally ask for Viktor's forgiveness.
I don't wanna!
Humph, I'm gonna tell Mr. Petrovsky!
That priest will tell you right is right and wrong is wrong.
He won't favor his own daughter.
Alright, we'll discuss this later at my office! Now get off the stage!
The first place of the hand launch gliders will not be awarded for now. Moving on to the category of rubber band-powered ornithopters—
The teacher shoos the three children off the stage.
Yekaterina clutches her elder sister's sleeve tightly with an angry flush.
Sofya does not plan on leaving just yet. She leads her little sister to the parents' row and brushes out Yekaterina's messy hair using her fingers.
Ugh, maybe I should get Dyadya Ivan to give you some MMA lessons before I go?
...No need, I'm actually a really good fighter. If it weren't for the grown-ups, I could've taken on five boys like him at the same time!
Pffft, right, okay, our Katya is the best.
Mama says Papa never means what he says when he's angry. He was just running his mouth when he said he couldn't stand the sight of you.
Just the thought of you studying all the way in Moscow makes him so sad he can't even eat.
Papa...
Sofya lets out a sigh. There is a maturity on her face that belies her age.
He wants to stop this world from getting any worse. How are prayers and worships supposed to achieve that?
...But that's Papa's faith.
He has his faith, and I have mine.
I will find a weapon that can actually fight the cataclysm...
Just then, the student on the stage finishes her acceptance speech, and the audience's applause interrupts what Sofya is saying.
With great envy and disappointment, Yekaterina watches as the girl descends from the stage with the certificate held reverently in her hands.
It's just a piece of paper! You'll soon learn how to fly real planes, which are way cooler than model ones!
Alright, I'll fly a huuuuge plane to Moscow to see you! Hm... but I won't bring Papa along!
Decrypting Attachment 9...
We have a brief report coming up.
A female middle schooler from Stavropol Krai has recently flown over Lake Sevan with a homemade hang glider without any professional guidance.
She lost control and fell into the water but was successfully rescued.
The Ministry of Education once again urges students to stay safe during the holidays and to avoid high-risk activities.
